data.one_liner: Simple state manager with built‑in dependency injection using observable values.
data.what_it_does: Cubes lets you create Cube classes that hold business logic and expose ObservableValues. Widgets rebuild only when those observables change, and Cubes are provided via a lightweight DI container.
use_when: You need lightweight state management without code generation.
You want built‑in DI and fine‑grained widget rebuilds.
avoid_when: Your app requires complex stream handling or advanced state features like bloc or riverpod.
You rely heavily on code‑gen tools for boilerplate reduction.
weaknesses: Smaller ecosystem compared to popular state libraries.
Limited advanced features (e.g., middleware, testing utilities).

alternatives.name: get_it
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides pure DI without additional state‑management layer.

alternatives.name: stacked_shared
alternatives.why_pick_it: Offers state management with DI and more built‑in utilities.

alternatives.name: flutter_modular
alternatives.why_pick_it: Combines DI and navigation for larger modular apps.
